value.rationale: Quantifies how reliably uniform random committees satisfy both representation and Pareto efficiency in a canonical one-dimensional adjacent-approval election, motivated by 2019 random-committee research and 2026 PO/JR complexity results. Offers an exact 4-state finite count, rigorous collapse of JR/PJR/EJR, and a sharp m^(2/3) reliability window with nontrivial e^(-lambda^3) critical law. Structural and stochastic value lies in the precise natural model, not in an unsupported universal theorem.
